verdict.rationale: Better Auth stores all auth data in your own standard database (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL and more), so the data is already in open, directly queryable formats you control. Community users confirm it: 'all your auth data in your own DB, with no lock-in', 'I own all the data', and the adapter design makes switching to another provider or library relatively easy. Passwords use the documented scrypt hashing algorithm, which aids portability. Missing for 10: a first-party export or migrate-away guide (the only documented migration is inbound from Auth0), and any documentation of data export from Better Auth's own hosted/cloud offerings.
